subject: Offer approval: base / bonus / equity tranching for Liam Ortega
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@talentpartners.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Candidate comp package for Liam Ortega (SDE2) — requesting approval

Hi Soojin / Karthik,

Following our intake and final loop with Liam, he has accepted in-principle interest pending a written offer. He has two asks: a slightly higher base and an acceleration of his RSU cliff because he indicated he has a competing offer. Per the hiring panel, the recommended package is below.

Proposed (standard SDE2 slot):
- Base: $172,000
- Target bonus: 10% (performance-based)
- RSU: 12,000 over 4 years (standard 1yr cliff / quarterly vest)
- Start window: flexible between Jan 10–Jan 31, 2027

Candidate expectations / asks:
- Wants base at $180k or the RSU front-loaded (first-year 50% vest)
- Request for pro-rated RSU if start delayed beyond Feb 1, 2027

I attached a comp matrix and the Q4 headcount view. Please confirm if we can:
1) Approve the recommended package as-is, or
2) Approve an exception to increase base to $180k (requires sign-off from Total Rewards), or
3) Approve front-loading 50% of year-1 RSUs (equity tranching) as a one-time exception.

Elaine
[Attachment: comp_matrix_L.Ortega.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)]
[Attachment: headcount_chart_Q4.pdf (pdf, 78KB)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Candidate comp package for Liam Ortega (SDE2) — requesting approval

Thanks Elaine — forwarding to Karthik and Laura for compensation sign-off. Quick notes from the hiring panel: Liam was strong on systems design and said he would join early if we can accommodate the base bump or some early liquidity (front-loaded RSUs). We have left some budget in the SDE2 band for Q4 hires but I don’t want to exceed the band without a clear case.

Laura / Karthik — can we do one of the following?
- Option A (preferred): Base $172k + front-load 50% of year-1 RSUs (so 6,000 vested at 6 months) — this helps liquidity without increasing run-rate base.
- Option B: Base $180k (total rewards + hiring manager approval required) — immediate run-rate impact.

Headcount: this hire is within the approved SDE2 headcount for Platform team; see attached headcount_chart_Q4.pdf. If you approve, I’ll ask Elaine to prepare an offer letter and include a candidate-facing explanation of vesting/prorating if start slips.

Appreciate a quick turn — candidate has another deadline next week.

Best,
Soojin
Director, Platform Eng
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 08:44:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Candidate comp package for Liam Ortega (SDE2) — requesting approval

On Sat, Nov 28, 2026 at 10:05 AM Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Elaine — forwarding to Karthik and Laura for compensation sign-off. Quick notes from the hiring panel: Liam was strong on systems design and said he would join early if we can accommodate the base bump or some early liquidity (front-loaded RSUs). We have left some budget in the SDE2 band for Q4 hires but I don’t want to exceed the band without a clear case.

Agree with Soojin — Option A is preferable from a cost perspective. A quick note on wording for the offer letter if we front-load: we should call it an "accelerated first-year vesting" schedule (not a change to company vesting policy) and explicitly state it is a one-time grant structure tied to hire date. That avoids setting precedent.

My ask: I can sign off on Option A (base stays at $172k; 50% of year-1 RSUs front-loaded) provided Total Rewards signs off on the final RSU language and legal confirms standard clauses. If Total Rewards is slow, I can approve a one-time manager-level exception to base up to $176k (compromise).

If everyone agrees, I’ll cc Total Rewards and Legal on the final doc.

—Karthik
VP, Engineering

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Elaine Park <elaine@talentpartners.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Candidate comp package for Liam Ortega (SDE2) — requesting approval

On Sun, Nov 29, 2026 at 08:44 AM, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Agree with Soojin — Option A is preferable from a cost perspective. A quick note on wording for the offer letter if we front-load: we should call it an "accelerated first-year vesting" schedule (not a change to company vesting policy) and explicitly state it is a one-time grant structure tied to hire date. That avoids setting precedent.

Approved.

I sign off on Option A: keep base at $172,000, grant 12,000 RSUs with an accelerated first-year vesting of 50% of year-1 RSUs at the 6-month milestone. Target bonus at 10% stands. Please include a clause that clarifies pro-rating if start date slips past Feb 1, 2027.

Elaine — you have approval to prepare the formal offer letter using the attached comp matrix as the draft. Karthik, Soojin — please loop Total Rewards (cc: totalrewards@redwood.ai) on the final equity language to get their brief confirmation. Once we have that, we can extend the offer and request a signed acceptance before Dec 6, 2026 to meet the candidate's timeline.

Thanks — Laura
Head of Talent & Total Rewards (acting)
Redwood Inference
